prep.namesLandWhen: Call sheets on every room. PFF scan until they enter. Stamp when On3 or the beat verifies.

thesis.line: NIL decides how many of those 10–12 Florida can actually buy.

rooms.dek: Both tackle spots. Most expensive portal buy. 2027 true freshmen are not Year-1 SEC starters.
rooms.hunt: Power-conference tackle who can start in 2027. Length, 2+ years left. Two if the budget holds.
